# Crate Map

The `foks-rs` workspace contains twenty-four library and binary crates plus the
Tauri desktop package. Line counts are rough, from `wc -l` over Rust sources
in September 2026, and are given only to convey relative size.

## Foundations

| Crate | Size | Purpose | Chapters |
|---|---|---|---|
| `foks-snowpack` | 1.9k | Canonical Snowpack codec, byte-compatible with Go v0.1.9 | 9 |
| `foks-proto` | 12.7k | The FOKS v0.1.9 protocol types | 9, 17 |
| `foks-crypto` | 10.0k | Primitives, key suites, hybrid boxes, HESP phrases, KEX | 3–7 |
| `foks-merkle-store` | 1.0k | Storage-neutral Patricia Merkle tree, proofs, epoch history | 11, 12 |
| `foks-verify` | 8.1k | Stateless verification of host, user, and team chains | 10, 13 |
| `foks-rpc` | 8.6k | Snowpack RPC framing, client calls, mutual TLS | 17 |
| `foks-protocol-metadata` | 1.5k | Validation and generation of pinned protocol IDs | 23 |
| `foks-compat-artifact` | 0.6k | Signed hosted-compatibility lease format | 23 |

| Crate | Size | Purpose | Chapters |
|---|---|---|---|

## Dependency order

`foks-snowpack` → `foks-proto` → `foks-crypto` → `foks-verify` →
`foks-client-db` → `foks-client` → `foks-client-app` → `foks-agent`, with
`foks-client` also depending directly on `foks-merkle-store` and `foks-rpc`
(both built on `foks-proto`), and with `foks-agent-proto` and
`foks-agent-client` as the seam on which `foks-cli`, `foks-mcp`,
`foks-desktop`, and the Tauri app sit. The server chain is `foks-server` →
`foks-server-db` → {`foks-merkle-store`, `foks-crypto`}, and `foks-server`
also uses `foks-rpc` and `foks-verify`. The default
`cargo test` members are the seven core crates: `client-db`, `crypto`,
`proto`, `snowpack`, `verify`, `client`, and `rpc`.
